A single experienced developer performs all work; effort is expressed in 8-hour workdays.
The Spring XD admin UI is based on the existing framework and U1 requires only front-end changes without backend modifications.
RPM scripts already exist and only need to be relocated and documented, not authored from scratch.
Kryo deserialization problems manifest as com.esotericsoftware.kryo.KryoException or subclasses in the Rabbit bus path.
No production deployment or infrastructure setup is required for estimation; testing uses existing local/dev environments.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories, define technical approach for retry configuration, property overrides, module/container ID exposure, dependency upgrades, and repo consolidation. Produce design notes.
Create/modify the Spring XD admin UI landing page to provide higher-order links for sources, processors, sinks, and jobs.

activities.activity_name: RabbitMQ retry exception configuration and fixes (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement configurable retryable exceptions in RabbitMessageBus at bus/stream property level, disable retry for Kryo deserialization issues, fix ClassNotFoundException for AMQP MessageConversionException, and ensure messaging MessageConversionException stops retries.
Update dependency version, resolve any API changes, and verify message channel improvements via test suite.
Update Spring Integration Kafka extension dependency and adapt code to leverage performance improvements.
Update Spring Hadoop dependency to 2.2.0 GA and validate Hadoop module functionality.
Provide access to module ID and container ID (e.g., via Spring Environment properties or context bean) so components can include them in logs; add example/documentation.
Allow overriding Kafka consumer (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize) and producer (batchSize, batchTimeout) defaults via module deployment properties.
Move XD and XD+Ambari RPM build scripts into a single public repository with appropriate structure and README.
Perform integration testing across all changes, including message bus behavior, UI, upgrades, and property overrides; fix defects.
Update user guide, configuration reference, and release notes for all new features and upgrades.
